# Nodewise

> India studio for B2B website and web application engineering. We write Next.js, Node, and Python. No WordPress. Sites from ₹20,000 INR. Web applications ₹1–1.5 lakh. Custom platforms quoted. Published INR pricing. Worldwide delivery.

Site: https://nodewise.cc
Contact: contact@nodewise.cc
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919446998827
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nodewise-cc

## Who we help

- B2B companies that need a company site or landing page
- Teams that need a web application: portal, dashboard, or internal tool

## Offer

- Websites: ₹20,000 for Home, About, and Enquiry. Extra pages priced in the calculator with no cap (₹22,000 / ₹23,500 / ₹25,000 then +₹1,500 per page). Next.js on Vercel, no WordPress, no maintenance retainer. Source and repo handed over.
- Web applications: ₹1–1.5 lakh INR. Next.js, Node APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, dashboards, portals, light automation.
- Custom platforms: quoted. Multi-user systems, WebSockets, Python, RAG, Gemini/Mistral, realtime voice, custom models.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, HTML/CSS, responsive UI, Plotly
- Backend: Node.js, Next.js route handlers, Python, WebSockets, REST APIs, webhooks
- Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Supabase Auth, OTP auth, session/cache
- Cloud: Vercel, Supabase Cloud, VPS
- AI (platforms): Mistral, Gemini, Gemini Live, OpenAI Realtime, Ultravox, speech-to-speech, RAG, fine-tuning
